department: Faculty of Science — Department of Mathematics

deadline.value: Main Round and HKPFS application deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 per CUHK Graduate School (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test in Mathematics is not universally required but may be required in some cases.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination in Mathematics may also be required in some cases.

supervisor.value: Prospective applicants are advised to approach professors early to discuss research fields; the Accelerated MPhil-PhD option directly after a bachelor's degree requires a prospective supervisor's recommendation.
supervisor.quote: Non-final-year undergraduates aiming for graduate studies in Mathematics are advised to approach professors early to discuss their proposed fields of research and expectations in graduate school.

also.quote: Since 2004, qualified undergraduate degree holders and MPhil students may opt for our Accelerated MPhil-PhD degree programme to study for a PhD directly. It is more demanding on the student and requires a recommendation from the prospective supervisor apart from typical application procedures.

funding.value: Financial aid (CUHK Postgraduate Studentships of HK$229,200/yr in 2026-27) is available to qualified full-time research postgraduate students.

also.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Admits both qualified undergraduate degree holders (via Accelerated MPhil-PhD with supervisor recommendation or MPhil stream) and MPhil/master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Since 2004, qualified undergraduate degree holders and MPhil students may opt for our Accelerated MPhil-PhD degree programme to study for a PhD directly.

notes: Department's own /postgraduates/research-programmes page still displays the prior year's 2025 deadline; Graduate School lists Main Round: 1 December 2026 for 2027-28 entry.
